_meta.description: Cross-translation English surface aliases keyed by Strong's number. Each list holds distinct English surfaces (lowercase, no leading article) used across KJV, NASB, ESV, NIV, BSB, NLT, ASV, NRSV for that word. The loader unions a token's list with its BSB surface so the renderer's substring scan matches whichever translation is displayed.
_meta.generated: generate_aliases.py (LLM, top ~2,000 words), kjv_aliases.py (KJV archaic forms), build_step_aliases.py (STEP TAHOT/TAGNT English renderings)
